name: kreatoai
description: Publish and schedule social media posts on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Bluesky, Google Business, Pinterest and Threads from your conversation.

interface.longDescription:
Kreatoai lets you publish and schedule your social media posts right from your conversation. Connect your accounts once, then ask ChatGPT in plain language.

Works with Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Bluesky, Google Business, Pinterest and Threads.

Just ask, for example:
• "Post this photo on Instagram and Facebook now"
• "Schedule my video on TikTok and YouTube for tomorrow at 6 pm"
• "Prepare and schedule my posts for the whole week"

What you can do
• Connect Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn or YouTube without leaving the conversation: ChatGPT gives you a link, you sign in to the network, and it is done
• Write a post and publish it now, or schedule it for a precise date and time
• Send the same post to several accounts at once, with a text suited to each network
• Attach an image or a video from a link, or send it from your phone or computer through a secure upload link
• See what is scheduled, check that a post went out and get its link
• Move, edit or cancel a scheduled post before it goes out
• See how your posts perform: views, likes, comments and shares, by network, by account or post by post
• Read the comments under your Facebook and Instagram posts, reply to them or hide them
• Read your Messenger and Instagram direct messages and reply to them

You stay in control: ChatGPT shows you what it is about to publish, send or cancel, and waits for your confirmation. The assistant only accesses your Kreatoai workspace: never your passwords or your payment details.

Good to know
• Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Pinterest need an image or a video with each post. Facebook, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Google Business and Threads also accept text only.
• Bluesky, Google Business, Pinterest and Threads are connected on kreatoai.com.
• A Kreatoai account is required.
capabilities: Check whether a post went out
defaultPrompt: Connect my Instagram account to Kreatoai.
Plan three posts about my business for next week and schedule them on Facebook and Instagram.
Which of my posts got the most views this month?

positive.prompt: Which social media accounts are connected to my Kreatoai workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: Read only, no confirmation. Lists the Facebook Page "Campus Plus" with its platform (facebook), its channelId and isDefault=true.

positive.description: Read the plan and what is scheduled
positive.prompt: Which plan is my Kreatoai workspace on, and what is already scheduled?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the plan (Creator, active) and the scheduled posts, including the two sample posts of March 1 and March 15, 2027, with status "scheduled".

positive.prompt: Write a short Facebook post announcing a free Excel workshop and schedule it on my Campus Plus Page for March 20, 2027 at 10:00 Paris time.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the draft, asks for confirmation, then schedules it for 2027-03-20T10:00:00+01:00 on the Facebook Page. Returns a post id and status "scheduled". Nothing is published before that date.

positive.description: Move and edit the scheduled post
positive.prompt: Move that post to March 21, 2027 at 9:00 and replace 'free' with 'open to all'.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirmation, updates the post created in the previous case: same post id, new date and new text, status still "scheduled".

positive.prompt: Cancel the post scheduled for March 21, 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the post, asks for confirmation, then cancels it. Status "cancelled"; nothing was ever published.

negative.description: X (Twitter) is not supported: the assistant explains it and lists the supported networks, and no post is created.
negative.prompt: Post this announcement on my X (Twitter) account.

negative.description: Video creation is not supported: the assistant explains that Kreatoai publishes videos the user already has but does not create them, and calls no write tool.
negative.prompt: Make me a 30-second promotional video for my Page.

negative.description: A post cannot be scheduled in the past: the assistant asks for a future date, and the API rejects a past date.
negative.prompt: Schedule this post on my Campus Plus Page for yesterday at 10:00.

review.commerce_description: Kreatoai sells nothing inside ChatGPT. The plugin only publishes and manages posts in the user's existing Kreatoai workspace.

publication.release_notes: Kreatoai lets users publish and schedule posts on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Bluesky, Google Business, Pinterest and Threads from ChatGPT. Version 1.0.3 updates the listing to match the tools already published on the MCP server (https://api.kreatoai.com/mcp/social): get_workspace, list_accounts, request_connect_link, create_post, get_post, list_posts, update_post, cancel_post, upload_media, get_analytics, list_comments, reply_to_comment, hide_comment, list_conversations, get_conversation and send_message. Authentication is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; ChatGPT is recognized through its client metadata document. No server or authentication change.

fr-FR.subtitle: Publiez sur tous vos réseaux
fr-FR.description:
Kreatoai publie et programme vos publications sur les réseaux sociaux, directement depuis la conversation. Reliez vos comptes une fois, puis demandez simplement à ChatGPT.

Fonctionne avec Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Bluesky, Google Business, Pinterest et Threads.

Demandez simplement, par exemple :
• « Publie cette photo sur Instagram et Facebook maintenant »
• « Programme ma vidéo sur TikTok et YouTube demain à 18 h »
• « Prépare et programme mes publications de toute la semaine »

Ce que vous pouvez faire
• Relier Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn ou YouTube sans quitter la conversation : ChatGPT vous donne un lien, vous vous connectez au réseau, c'est fait
• Écrire une publication et la publier tout de suite, ou la programmer à une date et une heure précises
• Envoyer la même publication sur plusieurs comptes à la fois, avec un texte adapté à chaque réseau
• Joindre une image ou une vidéo à partir d'un lien, ou l'envoyer depuis votre téléphone ou votre ordinateur par un lien sécurisé
• Voir ce qui est programmé, vérifier qu'une publication est partie et obtenir son lien
• Décaler, modifier ou annuler une publication programmée avant son départ
• Voir ce que donnent vos publications : vues, j'aime, commentaires et partages, par réseau, par compte ou publication par publication
• Lire les commentaires sous vos publications Facebook et Instagram, y répondre ou les masquer
• Lire vos messages privés Messenger et Instagram et y répondre

Vous gardez la main : ChatGPT vous montre ce qu'il va publier, envoyer ou annuler, et attend votre accord. L'assistant n'accède qu'à votre espace Kreatoai : jamais à vos mots de passe ni à vos moyens de paiement.

Bon à savoir
• Instagram, TikTok, YouTube et Pinterest demandent une image ou une vidéo pour chaque publication. Facebook, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Google Business et Threads acceptent aussi le texte seul.
• Bluesky, Google Business, Pinterest et Threads se relient sur kreatoai.com.
• Un compte Kreatoai est nécessaire.
